# Shareon 2.8.1

Self-hosted copy of [Shareon](https://shareon.js.org/) (MIT License, Nikita Karamov), pinned to version 2.8.1.

- `shareon.min.css` and `shareon.iife.js` are the official dist files from the npm package `shareon@2.8.1`.
- Do not load these from a CDN; the site's blog posts link to this folder.
- To upgrade, replace the files with a newer official release and update `VERSION`.
